segments.comment: A third Big Room level teleport, on a seed whose rnd(13) variant is bigrm-12: two hexagons whose pools are rewritten by a chain of des.replace_terrain({ fromterrain, toterrain }) calls over the whole map through lspo_replace_terrain, then des.wallify. Seeds 7306-7335 were replayed with the port to read each seed's variant; 7315 is the first bigrm-12. See bigroom-level-teleport for the level menu.
